responsibility: Implements pretty-printing of the D front-end AST back into source-like text, including `.di` import-header generation. It walks statements, expressions, types, declarations, template parameters, and modules to emit syntactically correct D text into an `OutBuffer`, formats storage classes, linkage, trust, and protection attributes, and provides the concrete visitors behind the public header-generation and AST-to-buffer APIs declared in `hdrgen.h`.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual AST pretty-printer and header/source regeneration visitors, including `.di` emission and textual formatting helpers, whereas `hdrgen.h` only exposes the public buffer-generation APIs and generation-state structure.
